plan.data: Only official HAR TRAIN X and subject IDs; validation subjects 3,8,17,25
plan.selection: maximum validation-query k=15 population overlap; tie by trustworthiness
plan.restrictions: No class labels, official TEST rows, best-seed selection or early stopping
plan.evaluation: 256 fixed validation queries against all official TRAIN rows; 3 fixed 64-point validation PH subclouds; raw AND scale-aligned costs
plan.caveat: Reused development split. Longer runs are explicitly not compute matched.
